info.title: API.SH: LiveAuctioneers
info.description: The LiveAuctioneers API from API.SH: public LiveAuctioneers data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
One auction (catalog) on LiveAuctioneers: title, status, sale type, start and estimated end, lot count, absentee bidders, currency, preview text, description, buyer's premium, payment options, address, the auction house, terms and conditions, shipping options, bid increments, and one page of its lots (keyword search inside the catalog and sort). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page. `latest=true` opens the first upcoming auction of the calendar.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/liveauctioneers-auction

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Auction id (`auction_id` in search) or its liveauctioneers.com/catalog/... link.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keywords to search inside the catalog.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Buyer reviews of an auction house on LiveAuctioneers, 25 a page: headline, text, date, star ratings (overall, accuracy, payment, responsiveness, shipping), the reviewer's first name and place as shown on the site, the auction reviewed, and the house's public replies; plus the rating summary. Filter by stars and sort. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/liveauctioneers-auctioneer-reviews

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Auction house id or its liveauctioneers.com/auctioneer/... link.

parameters.name: stars
parameters.description: Only reviews with this overall rating.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Upcoming auctions on LiveAuctioneers (the site's auction calendar), with its filters: date, country, sale type, shipping, auction house, top-rated houses and live-streamed auctions. Each auction: `id`, `title`, `url`, `status`, `sale_type`, `sale_start`, `sale_end_estimated`, `lot_count`, `currency`, `preview`, `description`, buyer's premium, payment options and the `auction_house`. `facets` lists the filter values with counts. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/liveauctioneers-auctions

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Country name as in `facets.country`, e.g. `United States`, `United Kingdom`.

parameters.name: house
parameters.description: Auction house ids from `facets.house`, comma separated.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One lot on LiveAuctioneers: every field of a search result (estimates, current bid, bid count, sold price, images, auction, auction house, location, shipping options) plus the full `description` (text and HTML), `condition_report`, dimensions and weights, the lot's `categories`, `creators`, `materials`, `origins` and `style_periods`, and the `bid_history` of a closed lot (amount, currency, source, anonymous bidder number). `latest=true` with search params (e.g. `q`) opens the first lot of that search.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/liveauctioneers-lot

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Lot id (`id` in search) or its liveauctioneers.com/item/... link.

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: `true`: the first lot of a search with the other params (`q`, filters).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Lots on LiveAuctioneers (liveauctioneers.com: art, antiques, jewelry, watches, coins, collectibles from thousands of auction houses) for a keyword, with every filter of the site's search page: upcoming lots or sold prices (`status=sold`), category, creator/brand, material, style period, origin, art subject, auction house (include or exclude), country, state, sale type, shipping, payment, top-rated houses, current bid, estimate, hammer price and buyer's premium ranges, sale and listing dates, and every sort. `facets` lists each filter's values with ids and counts (leave out with `facets=false`). Each lot: `id`, `title`, `url`, `lot_number`, `short_description`, `images`, `currency`, `estimate_low`/`estimate_high`, `start_price`, `current_bid`, `bid_count`, `sold_price`, `buy_now_price`, the site's `market_estimate`, `status`, `sale_type`, `sale_start`, `lot_end_estimated`, the auction (`auction_id`, `auction_title`, `auction_url`), `auction_house` (id, name, place, rating, review count, top rated), lot `location`, `shipping` options and `raw`. `total` is the site's count (it reports at most 10,000). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/liveauctioneers-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keywords, e.g. `rolex`, `tiffany lamp`. Leave empty to browse with filters.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: `upcoming` (default): lots open for bidding; `sold`: past lots with their hammer prices.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category ids from `facets.category` (e.g. `6` jewelry), comma separated.

parameters.name: creator
parameters.description: Creator or brand ids from `facets.creator` (e.g. `21252` Rolex), comma separated.

parameters.name: material
parameters.description: Material and technique ids from `facets.material`, comma separated.

parameters.name: style
parameters.description: Style period ids from `facets.style`, comma separated.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: Origin ids from `facets.origin` (e.g. `191` European), comma separated.

parameters.name: house
parameters.description: Auction house ids from `facets.house` (e.g. `957`), comma separated.

parameters.name: exclude_house
parameters.description: Auction house ids to leave out, comma separated.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Country codes as in `facets.country` (e.g. `US`, `UK`, `IE`), comma separated.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: State or province codes as in `facets.region` (e.g. `CA`, `NY`), comma separated.

parameters.name: top_rated
parameters.description: `true`: only lots from top-rated auction houses.

parameters.name: price_min
parameters.description: Current bid at least (whole number, lot currency).

parameters.name: facets
parameters.description: `false` leaves out the facet lists (smaller answer).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Search suggestions from LiveAuctioneers' search box for a partial term: suggested search terms and matching auction houses (with `auction_house_id`).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/liveauctioneers-suggest

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
